entries.b30f46d67f54d6fb: The Interior Building Materials Business operates through sales offices across the country and is characterized by an agile delivery system for materials sales. It is stated that the company plans to share sales and logistics bases between the nationwide Interior Building Materials Business and the Exterior Business, which is centered on the Kansai region, and to create synergies through sharing know-how in the group's areas of strength and through personnel exchanges. In the Living Environment-Related Business, a review of the cost structure is also under way, including partial in-house handling of delivery.

entries.dac54f1f37296e96: There are three reportable segments: the Interior Building Materials Business, the Exterior Business and the Living Environment-Related Business; revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥18,078 million for the Interior Building Materials Business, ¥12,895 million for the Exterior Business and ¥4,469 million for the Living Environment-Related Business. There is no revenue from external customers outside Japan, and no specific customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue. The business mainly targets private-sector capital investment in domestic office buildings, commercial facilities, condominiums and individual houses.
entries.e7118f4f88a82bcf: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥35,444 million, up 1.8% from the previous period. The Interior Building Materials Business stayed roughly flat at ¥18,078 million, the Exterior Business rose 4.8% from the previous period to ¥12,895 million in sales, and the Living Environment-Related Business rose 0.2% from the previous period to ¥4,469 million. The Exterior Business is said to have benefited from capturing rush demand ahead of a legal revision and from sales promotion campaigns, while the Living Environment-Related Business is said to have taken the first step toward improvement, supported by an increase in construction orders and other factors.
entries.edab55d74689aa4b: A specialized construction materials trading company headquartered in Nagoya that sells interior building materials, exterior products and living environment-related products.
entries.fec2054d2ef1b6db: This is a reportable segment handled by the company. The company sells interior construction materials, such as lightweight steel base materials and gypsum board, mainly to interior finishing contractors that carry out ceiling finishing and partition work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥18,078 million, the largest of the segments.
